remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

spec2def(pdh.dll pdh.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# pdh.dll is all Rust (pdh-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/pdh-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# pdh_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/pdh-rust/src/pdh/pdh_main.rs)
add_cargo_module(pdh pdh-cargo pdh.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE pdh-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
